intent: Record as reviewed the criterion, snapshot, dataset, rubric and purge rules the testlab Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context testlab lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Changing the text of an acceptance criterion clears its confirmation, so a person must confirm the new wording.
A snapshot's content hash covers the prompt with the criteria, datasets, rubric and facts, so any edit freezes a new snapshot and earlier ones stay as they were.
A snapshot can be rerun only while its Test Case is not deleted and every dataset it references exists, is not deleted and has not expired.
A dataset can be deleted only through the Test Case that owns it; naming another Test Case finds nothing and removes nothing.
A Workspace that may not store objects cannot upload a dataset; the upload is answered not found before anything is stored.
A rubric is accepted only when every item names an existing acceptance criterion, and deleting a criterion removes its rubric item.
Purging a Workspace erases only the Test Cases no snapshot froze, so past runs keep the Test Case they ran.
Continuing a run freezes a new snapshot of the same Test Case whose content hash covers the new prompt, and leaves the earlier snapshot as it was.
